1.web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:
1.asv: I exhort therefore, first of all, that supplications, prayers, intercessions, thanksgivings, be made for all men;

2.web: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
2.asv: for kings and all that are in high place; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and gravity.

3.web: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;
3.asv: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

4.web: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
4.asv: who would have all men to be saved, and come to the knowledge of the truth.

5.web: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
5.asv: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, himself man, Christ Jesus,

6.web: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;
6.asv: who gave himself a ransom for all; the testimony to be borne in its own times;

7.web: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
7.asv: whereunto I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth, I lie not), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

8.web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
8.asv: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.

9.web: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;
9.asv: In like manner, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefastness and sobriety; not with braided hair, and gold or pearls or costly raiment;

10.web: but (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.
10.asv: but (which becometh women professing godliness) through good works.

11.web: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.
11.asv: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

12.web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
12.asv: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to have dominion over a man, but to be in quietness.

13.web: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
13.asv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;

14.web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
14.asv: and Adam was not beguiled, but the woman being beguiled hath fallen into transgression:

15.web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.
15.asv: but she shall be saved through her child-bearing, if they continue in faith and love and sanctification with sobriety.
